specification.objective: Remove redundant Kanban/project context from the accent navbar, replace board-loading spinners with responsive static skeletons, reduce avoidable rebuild/allocation/paint work on the Kanban page and drag path, and bootstrap a repository POLIS policy that mirrors the existing backend+frontend complete-test CI command without changing Kanban persistence semantics or adding dependencies.

requirements.statement: The accent top navigation must retain menu access and TOUCHIN branding but render neither a Kanban title nor the selected project name.
Whenever the project snapshot/board is loading, the board region must render responsive static skeleton lanes/cards instead of a centered CircularProgressIndicator.
Controller notifications must no longer rebuild the static Scaffold, Drawer, and top navigation; only the controller-driven page body should rebuild.

Raw-pointer drag motion must update the floating preview independently and rebuild the board only when the resolved drop target changes, while preserving the existing custom pointer drag/drop semantics.

Kanban scrolling and paint work must keep fixed-extent virtualization while adding bounded cache extents and explicit repaint boundaries without reintroducing Draggable, DragTarget, ReorderableListView, or external packages.
Controller project/member/task collection getters must return stable immutable snapshots instead of allocating a new unmodifiable list on every read.

The repository must gain .polis/policy.json using Project Policy schema v3, standard validation, and a complete-test command that runs backend pytest followed by frontend flutter test, matching the current CI test intent.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A keyed kanban-topbar contains TOUCHIN and no Kanban/project context, with regression coverage inspecting the topbar subtree.
A delayed board API shows exactly one kanban-board-skeleton, no ProjectKanbanBoard and no CircularProgressIndicator in the board-loading state, then swaps to the live board after completion.
ProjectKanbanPage places _KanbanTopBar outside the AnimatedBuilder and the builder rebuilds only _buildPageBody.
ProjectKanbanBoard owns a ValueNotifier<Offset> drag pointer and ValueListenableBuilder preview; pointer moves with an unchanged target return without setState.
Horizontal/vertical scroll views use bounded cacheExtent values, child delegates disable automatic repaint boundaries, and explicit RepaintBoundary nodes isolate board/lane/card/preview paint work.
Projects, projectMembers, and tasks return stable list identities across unchanged reads and throw on mutation attempts because snapshots are frozen when assigned.
.polis/policy.json validates as schema v3/standard and its test.complete command contains both pytest and flutter test.

invariants.statement: Backend endpoints, API contracts, server-authoritative mutation ordering, optimistic concurrency/version checks, conflict reload semantics, stable card/column IDs, and permissions remain unchanged.
The existing square TouchIn visual language, compact project overview, compact 144px cards, responsive breakpoints, dialogs, and no-external-dependency constraint remain unchanged.
SliverFixedExtentList virtualization, persistent scroll controllers, raw Listener pointer handling, and existing drop-target resolution remain the Kanban rendering/interaction foundation.
The repository CI workflow is not modified; the new POLIS policy documents its complete backend/frontend test intent rather than replacing CI.

forbidden_states.statement: Navbar still displays Kanban or the selected project name.
Board loading falls back to a spinner-only state or an animated shimmer that continuously repaints the page.
Every pointer-move event triggers a full ProjectKanbanBoard setState regardless of whether the drop target changed.
Performance work changes persistence timing to optimistic local reordering, weakens conflict handling, adds dependencies, or restores previously rejected Flutter drag/reorder primitives.
The committed POLIS policy silently omits the repository's existing backend or frontend complete tests.

inputs.statement: Current ProjectKanbanPage rebuilds its full Scaffold/topbar on every ProjectKanbanController notification and shows a centered CircularProgressIndicator while isLoadingBoard is true.
Current raw pointer drag calls setState for every PointerMoveEvent, rebuilding lanes/cards even when the resolved drop target has not changed.

Current ProjectKanbanController getters allocate List.unmodifiable wrappers on each projects/projectMembers/tasks read, while CI runs pytest and flutter test and the repository has no committed POLIS policy.

outputs.statement: Identity-only TOUCHIN navbar and responsive static board skeleton loading state.
Narrower controller rebuild boundary, lower drag-move rebuild frequency, explicit repaint isolation/cache bounds, and stable immutable snapshot lists.
Committed .polis/policy.json defining the repository complete-test gate for future POLIS deliveries.

failure_semantics.statement: With only the focused regression tests installed on the baseline, the regression command exits 1 and prints kanban_performance_loading_missing.
Any Flutter compile/layout/test failure remains authoritative; because Flutter is unavailable in the packaging environment, the artifact must not claim those tests executed locally.
If the new standard repository POLIS policy is used in an environment without pytest or Flutter, its complete-test gate fails rather than silently degrading validation.
